tagline: Leading provider of test and measurement solutions for semiconductor manufacturing
hero_kpi_rationale: Probe card revenue represents the core of FormFactor's business, accounting for 81% of total revenue in 2025 and directly reflecting demand in foundry, DRAM, and Flash memory.

kpis.name: Probe Cards Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of semiconductor test probe cards

kpis.name: Systems Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of test systems (thermal stations, probe stations, cryogenic systems)

kpis.name: Consolidated Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue remaining after deducting cost of revenue, reflecting operational efficiency
kpis.description: Consolidated gross margin (gross profit divided by total revenue)

kpis.name: Research and Development Expenses
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue allocated to research and development
kpis.description: Research and development expenses as a percentage of total revenue

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Investments in physical assets for infrastructure and manufacturing equipment

kpis.name: HBM DRAM Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from test cards for high-bandwidth DRAM memory used in artificial intelligence
kpis.description: DRAM segment revenue, driven by demand for HBM in generative AI applications

ai_positioning.summary: FormFactor is positioned as a key player in AI infrastructure, notably through the acquisition of Keystone Photonics in December 2025 to strengthen its position in silicon photonics (SiPh) and co-packaged optics. Growth in HBM DRAM for generative AI applications contributes significantly to revenue growth.
evidence: Acquisition of Keystone Photonics in December 2025 for AI infrastructure and growth in the silicon photonics market
DRAM revenue growth of 99.9% in FY2024 and +8.8% in FY2025, primarily driven by demand for HBM designs in generative AI applications
Manufacturing expansion in June 2025 (Farmers Branch, Texas) to support anticipated growth
